name: Knock It Out of Their Hands

description.value:
Requirement The target is wielding a weapon you can see.

Killing them was one option. This one is louder in the retelling.

Make a ranged Strike at a −2 penalty against the target's weapon rather than the target. On a hit the weapon is knocked from its grip and lands 10 feet away in a direction you choose; on a critical hit it is also broken if it is a scrap gun. A creature with the weapon secured, integrated, or otherwise attached is instead off-guard until the end of your next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: this is exactly bucket 4's language: "an effect targeting a DIFFERENT creature's own item.". This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
